Note: Biography quest rewards are listed above; guides on how to complete the quests are shown on their respective reward item pages. Cheers.

Current Maris update: Chapter 4.4: Summer Triangle
Papaya Link: uwo.papayaplay.com/uwo.do?tp=news.view&postid=5187

Schedule of future updates from JP server:

Update 4.6: Yggdrasil -- tinyurl.com/UWO-7WondersYggdrasil
(Unlock your true potential with the lost power of Yggdrasil, new letter of appreciation effects, new aide skills via Sagres and optional ship skills, new Colosseum battles, and more discoveries... a tree-mendous new adventure awaits!)

Update 4.7: Nelson -- tinyurl.com/UWO-7WondersNelson
(The 19th anniversary update of UWO brings a return of Grande Ganadors with new and frightening powers, even better loot to craft with their golden logbooks, new discoveries, the second of Yggdrasil's mythical gemstones to obtain and empower, and a shipwreck with unusual surprises aboard...)

Update 4.9: Spica -- tinyurl.com/UWO-7WondersSpica
(The Sky Atlas expands with new charting possibilities for the starry heavens above, the third Yggdrasil stone unleashes its power, Sagres' aide school adds new courses and powerful skills for your trusty companions, and the Biography quests add Geography and Accounts to the mix. As usual, new discoveries also lie in store. Yo ho yo ho, it's a voyager's life for we.)

Update 4.10: Caravan -- tinyurl.com/UWO-7WondersCaravan
(2 new ships, another epic biography, a new city and the ability to form your own camel-based caravans. Wait, no alpacas? Oh well. This release should be quite engaging! Possibly pungent as well. Cheers.)

==========================
Historical Figures(Epic Biography)
==========================

100,000 fame requirement

1. When you are eligible, the Book of Wisdom shines the next time you enter the docks of any port.
2. Take the Hamburg carriage and speak with Alias in Frankfurt's tavern to unlock Historical Figures tab in the Book of Wisdom.

To play a chapter from Epic Biography, select a story theme from the HF tab and click 'Begin'. The story chapter will begin. Caution: you can only perform 1 chapter of a single Epic Biography per real life day!

List of Epic Biographies (guides are posted under each reward item's page, click for details):

1. Commentariolus: The Geocentric Clergy (Astronomy +1)
2. Opera di Bartolomeo: The Celebrity Chef (Cooking +1)
3. Biography of Admiral Nelson: The One-eyed, One-armed hero (Penetration +1)
4. Dialogus de Systema Cosmicum: Galileo Galilei (Recognition +1)
5. The Lives: Michelangelo (Handicrafts +1)
6. The Doria's Talisman: Andrea Doria (Evasion +1)
7. Exquisite Navigator's Compass: Vasco Da Gama (Sail Handling +1) 4.4 Summer Triangle
